hypothesis: Every locked BM4_NL bend is exactly 90 degrees and the frozen ACCDB solver explicitly passes smooth90FlexibilityCorrection=false under a B31J-2017 factor profile, selecting the general 1.65/h flexibility coefficient. CAESAR B31J defines a specific smooth-90 correction using 1.3/h when the Smooth 90 option is active. Replacing only that Boolean with true should reveal whether the bend-factor basis, rather than an assumed base-beam shear law, is a major source of the remaining L19/L20 discrepancy.

authoritySources.authorityStatement: B31.3-2022 uses B31J-2017 by default; for a smooth 90-degree bend B31J calculates in-plane/out-of-plane flexibility from 1.3/h rather than the general B31.3 1.65/h basis. Bends also use load-case elbow stiffening elastic-modulus and pressure corrections.

experimentMatrix.mechanics: frozen solver plus accepted I015 plain-FRAME transverse-shear runtime patch

interpretationRules: The primary causal comparison is FROZEN_BASELINE -> FROZEN_PLUS_SMOOTH90. I015 is not a prerequisite for judging the bend correction.
I015_PARENT -> I015_PLUS_SMOOTH90 is retained only to measure mechanism interaction/composition against the accepted historical parent.
Do not vary kappa, thermal expansion, EC/EH, Bourdon, pressure elongation, tee factors, reducer mechanics, restraint treatment, gravity, tolerances or CAESAR reference rows.
Retain all 12 bend pointers and exact nodal/end-action equilibrium.
A reaction-only improvement is insufficient; displacement/rotation and source-end-action fields must be reported in both experiment columns.
If the smooth-90 correction materially improves the frozen baseline, elevate bend-factor authority ahead of any further shear work.

If it materially worsens the system, retain the result as evidence that the saved CAESAR Smooth 90 setting may differ from the vendor/default B31J behavior and do not promote the candidate without job-specific authority.
decisionReason: Await exact-head four-column locked-ACCDB system A/B with no production source mutation.
